item.title: The real story behind Winnie the Pooh, the 100-year-old cartoon bear
item.description: Childhood favorite Winnie the Pooh is turning 100 this month. The story was written in England but quickly found a special place in the hearts of Americans. Tina Kraus and Bradley Blackburn team up to share this transatlantic tale.

item.title: Reported attacks on ships around Hormuz reach record highs
item.description: Data from a monitoring agency shows attacks around the Strait of Hormuz at a record high, as two more vessels report being attacked on Friday.

item.title: Ukraine still can't intercept drones due to Starlink issues, Zelenskyy says
item.description: The Ukrainian president said Starlink issues are hampering his country's defensive efforts against Russian drones.

item.title: EU diplomats say they were attacked by settlers in West Bank
item.description: Footage circulating online appears to show several diplomats being attacked in the vicinity of the village of Taybeh, Israeli police said.

item.title: In Kentucky campaign stop, Trump says he "can do stuff that is unbelievable"
item.description: President Trump spoke in the city of Highland Heights to boost Republican candidates, including Ed Gallrein​ for the U.S. House.

item.title: Feds probing suspicious letters to election officials, lawmakers
item.description: Federal investigators said they are looking into suspicious letters containing unknown substances that were mailed to state election officials and congressional offices.

item.title: Pope's surgeon details operating on "ideal patient" after lung cancer discovered
item.description: Pope Leo XIV was undergoing an examination for another reason when doctors discovered a tumor on his right lung, his doctor said.

item.title: Attorneys for Rep. Ilhan Omar accuse DOJ of violating judge's orders
item.description: Omar's attorneys asked the government to immediately return the congresswoman's property, and also demanded all video and audio recordings of the search be preserved.

item.title: Protests erupt in France against living costs, support of students
item.description: Police used tear gas to push back people wearing hoods and masks and throwing fireworks and other objects at officers in the Place de la République, northeast of the Paris city center.

item.title: This week on "Sunday Morning" (Oct. 18)
item.description: A look at the features for this week's broadcast of the Emmy-winning program, hosted by Jane Pauley.

item.title: Santo Taco transports New Yorkers to a Mexico City taquería
item.description: Mexican-style taco chain Santo Taco is serving up taquería classics to eager New Yorkers. Creator Santiago Perez was inspired by the flavors and traditions of Mexico City.

item.title: "Rent" returns to the West End for 30th anniversary revival
item.description: Beloved musical spectacle "Rent" is back on London's West End for its 30th anniversary. That's "525,600 minutes," times 30. Ramy Inocencio reports on the revival.

item.title: This electric hydrofoil boat could be the ferry of the future
item.description: Commuting can be a struggle, but a new electric hydrofoil ferry aims to make commuting across water smoother and more eco-friendly. Kris Van Cleave takes a ride.

item.title: Amelia Earhart and her plane vanished in 1937. A team is scouring a remote island for evidence.
item.description: A team of archaeologists is searching off a remote island in Kiribati for traces of Amelia Earhart's plane. Lana Zak has an update on their progress.

item.title: Saturday Sessions: Brothers Osborne perform "R.I.P."
item.description: Grammy Award-winning country duo Brothers Osborne are celebrating the 10 year anniversary of their debut album this year. The two have earned several platinum and gold certifications and have been streamed over 3.4 billion times worldwide. Their fifth studio album, "Watertown" celebrates their Maryland hometown on the shores of the Chesapeake Bay. Here are the Brothers Osborne with "R.I.P."

item.description: The 71-year-old pope had a portion of his right lung removed and received a diagnosis of lung cancer earlier this week.

item.title: Why Alberta is voting on its potential separation from Canada
item.description: Around 20% of Alberta residents want to formally separate from Canada — and they're putting it to a vote. Ian Lee has more.

item.title: Thousands evacuate as massive California fires engulf homes
item.description: Thousands of Californians are under evacuation orders as massive wildfires spread into urban areas, worsened by strong Santa Ana winds.

item.title: How a teacher tried to stop the Oregon school shooter
item.description: New details are emerging about a deadly shooting at Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend, Oregon. Ash-har Quraishi reports.

item.title: Eye Opener: Santa Ana winds fuel California fires
item.description: Santa Ana winds fuel California wildfires, plus Katie Zacharia is out as White House press secretary. All that and all that matters in today's Eye Opener.

item.title: 10/17: CBS Saturday Morning
item.description: Pope Leo is cleared to leave the hospital after lung surgery, plus Albertans speak on the vote to potentially leave Canada. All this and more.

item.title: Hero bystander, teacher praised for saving lives in school shooting
item.description: The bystander who pursued and killed the Silver Rail Elementary School shooter is thanking first responders and the community for their support.

item.title: Woman, 26, felt her concerns were being dismissed before cancer diagnosis
item.description: Andrea De Armas thought her concerns weren't being taken seriously. Then she received alarming information.

item.title: On economy, Vance says "we're turning the ship around"
item.description: As Americans express frustration with the country's economic outlook, Vice President JD Vance told CBS News this week it could take some time to see improvement.

item.title: Sacramento mom says hero son shot, killed Oregon school shooter
item.description: A Sacramento mother says her son acted on instinct when he confronted and fatally shot a gunman during a deadly school shooting in Oregon​, an attack that killed three children and a teacher.

item.title: Why visitors are flocking to Philadelphia's popular pigeon tour
item.description: The 90-minute tour, which TripAdvisor now ranks as the third most popular in Philadelphia, answers all your burning pigeon-related questions.

item.title: Vance calls El-Sayed a "weasel" as Michigan Senate race heats up
item.description: Abdul El-Sayed told Michigan voters the state's U.S. Senate race could go down "as one of the ugliest campaigns in modern history."
